DCTL.description: Design Control Data (DCTL). Fields describe global rating design control settings: frame sway classification per direction, automatic effective length factor calculation, and design type.

FRAMEX.description: X-Direction of Frame. Case-insensitive enum (wire strings). BRACED_NONSWAY -> braced non-sway frame; UNBRACED_SWAY -> unbraced sway frame.

FRAMEY.description: Y-Direction of Frame. Case-insensitive enum (wire strings). BRACED_NONSWAY -> braced non-sway frame; UNBRACED_SWAY -> unbraced sway frame.
